articles.title: How to begin learning Thai
articles.content: This original orientation introduces Thai as a system of meaningful forms used in context. Start with consonant classes, vowel length, tone rules and classifiers. Work in short sessions: listen or read, notice a pattern, retrieve it from memory, and use it in a new example. For historical, regional and specialist questions, consult the source list and seek qualified review.
